svg.title: Baker — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as baker, wearing an apron and a chef hat. Visible work cue: A broad scored loaf rests on a horizontal baking peel with a long downward handle. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a chef hat.
